title: Bride in Satin Wedding Gown, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot taken on January 17, 1949, capturing a bride in an ornate, voluminous satin wedding gown and veil. She lifts her gown while walking across a paved area near a brick structure. In the background, vintage 1940s automobiles and another guest in formal attire are visible.
